candidate: exact clean workflow SHA after harness commit; bound before dispatch

resources.environment: one ubuntu24.04 GitHub-hosted Linux AMD64 job
resources.placement: all owned processes share same four-CPU affinity; no dedicated physical-host claim
resources.late_preparation: reject control; do not extend age target
resources.note: original warmup/scrapes follow age release; actual first-window age retained
resources.constraints: Resolve current cgroup-v2 and all visible ancestor CPU/memory/cpuset controls; enforce unchanged identities/limits around blocks; distinguish root-not-applicable controls from missing non-root controls. No added quota/memory setting and no claim about invisible host parents.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shared host/product/driver CPU contention explains sustained original queue overload.
hypotheses.prediction: Pressure and driver waiting co-vary; high contention persists without extra RPC/alloc work. Controlled variance tests can reject version-only attribution; absent a causal resource intervention, correlation does not confirm original root cause.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different preparation age and sequential host evolution contribute to the observed version tail gap.
hypotheses.prediction: Same-binary repetitions and ABBA with common age reduce/shift the gap. No same-host unstandardized arm means this alone cannot prove age is causal.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The changed Slot ReadIndex or other shared read path has added repeatable version-specific cost.
hypotheses.prediction: After valid A/A, both B blocks in ABBA remain slower than both A blocks beyond observed B variation, with consistent server-stage/resource evidence and matching request work.

validity: exact unique product binary per variant and one driver
same profile/clean H and effective CPU/memory/affinity constraints
all planned blocks retained; unexpected errors or missing identity invalidate comparison
180-second control valid; record actual first-window time including warmup
no product process leakage between blocks
analysis_criteria.aa_rule: Same per-window verdict category; unexpected errors or missing evidence invalidate comparison. Passing repeatability controls require zero drops; consistent rejected windows remain red evidence rather than a success. Inspect all four B blocks for drift.
analysis_criteria.version_attribution: A/A must pass; ABBA differences must be consistent and exceed observed B variation. These thresholds are engineering diagnostic criteria, not significance claims or release limits.
analysis_criteria.cpu_denominator: sum completed list+sync including drain per window; three-node shared CPU only once; driver separate
analysis_criteria.quantiles: retain all window P99; median/mean of window P99 is not pooled P99
analysis_criteria.candidate_gate: C three diagnostic windows pass followed by all unchanged 20 endpoint results and v2 validator. Cross-check gate binary hash against frozen C and source H.
analysis_criteria.qualification_limit: Same-host Linux regression floor only; no formal release, no long soak, no migration candidate claim based on B.
analysis_criteria.relative_difference_formula: abs(x-y)/min(x,y); equivalent max/min <=1.25 for P99, <=1.10 for CPU
analysis_criteria.aa_median_definition: For each block and endpoint, median of three unprofiled window P99 values, not pooled P99
analysis_criteria.abba_main_comparison: B blocks4/5 versus A blocks3/6; separately expose cross-time B1/2/4/5 range and A3/A6 difference

invariants: fresh cluster and fixture for each block
no publication or paid cloud procurement
next_if_unresolved: Preserve all data and continue a predeclared one-variable experiment; do not declare historical root cause from a green run.
